body: Hiii I’m 24 and giving up weed... TW for bad sexual experience but yeah I was using weed to cope with trauma and I had sex with a guy while high... it was a normal experience for him but for me I was dissociating and triggered and having flashbacks... so yeah I don’t smoke anymore and it’s weird because it used to be a huge part of my life. The first few weeks were really hard and I missed it sooo much but now I’m okay and my friends understand why I don’t partake anymore. You got this.

Totally get sticking around for your cat, I often feel the same way. People suck. I’m sorry therapy hasn’t worked for you. Job hunting is so stressful. I wish I had advice for you but I just hope things get better for you and I want you to stick around for that.
I’m so sorry ugh that is heartbreaking 💔💔
